svg.text: walking on Eisenstein primes from 2 + ω
the hexagonal-lattice twin of the Gaussian moat: Z[ω], ω = e^(2πi/3), each prime drawn at its true place in the plane
window |Re z|, |Im z| ≤ 92; the √7 cluster continues past it (inset)
inset: the whole √7 cluster, |Re z|, |Im z| ≤ 519; box = main panel
Primes: norm 3 or a prime p = 1 mod 3, or a unit times
p = 2 mod 3; checked by brute-force factoring up to norm 700.
Each walk dies at a moat. Family 028 is about Gaussian
primes: the Eisenstein question has the same shape and
is not covered by it. No theorem is claimed here.
